SyncIntro: Your notes and photos sync directly over the same Wi-Fi. Keep both apps open. No account or external server.
SyncPair: 2. Add the app to the Home Screen
SyncPairHelp: Scan this code or open the address in Safari, then choose Share → Add to Home Screen. From now on open NoteBook from the Home Screen, not from Safari.
SyncNetworkHelp: If the page does not open, allow NoteBook through Windows Firewall on private networks only. Use the same Wi-Fi; guest network isolation can block the connection.
SyncResetConfirm: Disconnect all phones and require pairing again with a new code? Notes on phones stay there.
SyncPortBusy: The sync port is busy. Close the other instance and try again.
SetupIntro: Connect your phone to {0}. Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi.
SetupStep1: Download this computer’s trust certificate. Before trusting it, compare its SHA-256 fingerprint with the one on the computer.
SetupStep2: On iPhone: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → Downloaded Profile → Install.
SetupStep3: Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → turn ON the switch for this computer’s NoteBook certificate. Without this switch Safari shows “This Connection Is Not Private”.
SetupStep4: Open {0} in Safari, choose Share → Add to Home Screen, then open NoteBook from the Home Screen and type the code shown on the computer.
SetupFingerprint: Certificate SHA-256 fingerprint — compare with your computer:
SyncSetupHelp: Scan with the iPhone camera (or type the address in Safari). The page downloads this computer’s trust certificate and explains where to enable it in Settings.
SyncCodeHelp: In the app on the Home Screen tap Pair and type this code. A new code appears every {0} seconds; codes only exist while this window is open.
SetupCheckOk: Secure connection works. Open the app and add it to the Home Screen.
SetupCheckFail: Not trusted yet. Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → turn on the NoteBook certificate, then test again.
TrayHint: NoteBook keeps running here so your phone can sync. Right-click the icon to exit.
